deadline.value: Priority deadline for Fall is February 1; the department calls it a target date, not a strict cutoff.
deadline.quote: Priority deadline: February 1 | Applications submitted by this deadline will receive the strongest consideration for admission

gre_general.value: The department says the General and Subject GRE is optional for all applicants.
gre_general.quote: The General and Subject GRE is optional for all applicants.

gre_subject.value: The Physics subject GRE is optional for all applicants.
gre_subject.quote: The General and Subject GRE is optional for all applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Domestic applicants could have the fee waived in a Free Application Week (Oct 19-26, 2026). The department has no fee waiver otherwise.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee will be waived for domestic applications submitted during this window. | Free Application Week: October 19, 2026 - October 26, 2026

also.quote: There is no mechanism to waive application fees

toefl_min.value: The department's minimum is TOEFL iBT 71 from spring 2027 on, which covers Fall 2027 entry (its older rule was 79).
toefl_min.quote: Starting with the spring 2027 admission term, the minimum proficiency scores will be: | Minimum 71 TOEFL iBT score

ielts_min.value: The department's minimum is IELTS 6.0 from spring 2027 on, which covers Fall 2027 entry (its older rule was 6.5).
ielts_min.quote: Starting with the spring 2027 admission term, the minimum proficiency scores will be: | Minimum 6.0 IELTS score

supervisor.value: Admitted students choose a research advisor after required courses and the candidacy exam, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: admitted students affiliate themselves with a research advisor after they have completed the required courses and have passed the candidacy exam

funding.value: Every admitted PhD applicant is offered an assistantship. International students are admitted only with an assistantship and a full tuition scholarship.
funding.quote: 100% of admitted PhD applicants are offered an Assistantship. | Normally, we do not offer admission to US or to international applicants unless we are able to provide both an Assistantship and a full tuition scholarship

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter the PhD directly from a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: It is not necessary to already have a Masters degree (i.e., a Bachelor's degree is sufficient) to be admitted directly to the PhD program

notes: Physics Ph.D. only (the MA and MS are not saved). The Ph.D. page says the Fall priority deadline is Feb 1 with a 79/6.5 minimum; the same page says the 71/6.0 minimum starts with spring 2027, so 71/6.0 is saved. Astronomy has no separate PhD; astrophysics is a research area.
